homeScreen.introBody: Put the shop on your home screen, next to your other apps. It opens with one tap, full screen, without the browser bar. Nothing to download.
homeScreen.introOnce: This guide shows only once. Later, it is at the bottom of the page: “Add to home screen”.
homeScreen.installBody: Tap “Add”, then confirm in the window Chrome opens.
homeScreen.androidMenuBody: That's Chrome's menu. In Samsung Internet the menu is ≡ in the bottom right.
homeScreen.androidAddBody: Or “Install app”, depending on the phone.
homeScreen.androidConfirmBody: With “Add” or “Install”, and Marshal is on your home screen.
homeScreen.safari27Body: At the bottom, left of the address: the button with three lines. In it, choose “Share”.
homeScreen.safari26Body: At the bottom, right of the address. In the menu, choose “Share”.
homeScreen.safariShareShortcut: If you already see this button at the bottom, that is “Share”: tap it directly.
homeScreen.safari18Body: The square with an arrow pointing up, in the middle at the bottom. On an iPad it is in the top right.
homeScreen.iosChromeBody: The square with an arrow pointing up, on the right of the address field.
homeScreen.iosOtherBody: From the browser's menu. If it isn't there, open marshal.mk in Safari: it always works there.
homeScreen.iosAddBody: Scroll down the list and tap “Add to Home Screen”. If it isn’t there, tap “Edit Actions” at the bottom and add it.
homeScreen.iosConfirmBody: If you see “Open as Web App”, leave it on. Then tap “Add” in the top right, and Marshal is on your home screen.
homeScreen.inappMenuBody: Instagram and Facebook can't put a page on the home screen, so open it in a browser first.
homeScreen.inappOpenBody: It may also say “Open in Safari” or “Open in Chrome”, depending on the app.
homeScreen.inappThenTitle: There, at the bottom of the page
homeScreen.inappThenBody: In Safari or Chrome, tap “Add to home screen” at the bottom of the page, and the guide carries on there.
